result:
**Verdict: don't publish as written. One line needs to change.**

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "We've added a Japanese sencha to the shop" | Product fact (new product), fine |
| "grassy, a little sweet" | Flavour description, fine |
| "packed with antioxidants" | **Unsupported.** It's a health/nutrition claim, and section 3 bans health claims of any kind. It's also not on the allowlist. |
| "best brewed cooler than you think, around 70 degrees" | Brewing guidance, fine |

**Other checks**
- Banned words, slop and structure: no hits. No exclamation marks, em-dashes or rhetorical openers.
- Urgency, guarantees, superlatives, stats: none.
- Disclosure: not needed, since this is our own email and not a partnership or affiliate post.
- Voice: warm and plain, UK spelling. Fine.
- Approval: Sam needs to sign off, as with all public content.

**Suggested fix**

Replace "packed with antioxidants" with a flavour or origin fact from the product team, for example where the tea is grown or when it was picked. I haven't invented one, so add the real detail.

> Subject: A new green tea
>
> Hi Tom,
>
> We've added a Japanese sencha to the shop. It's grassy and a little sweet, [PROOF NEEDED: origin or harvest detail from the product team], and best brewed cooler than you think, around 70°C.
>
> The Pebblebrook team

I also changed "70 degrees" to "70°C" so the unit is clear. That's optional and not a blocker.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "packed with antioxidants", "type": "health_claim"}], "publish": false}
```
